title: Redwood February 2026 All-Hands
summary: Monthly company all-hands: Q1 metrics and cadence, product roadmap update (Dedicated and Private progress), reliability and latency wins, hiring and org priorities, security/compliance updates, and company OKRs. Ends with Q&A and clear next steps.
next_steps: Priya to share updated roadmap deck by 2026-02-18
Product to publish Dedicated SLA draft next week (2026-02-21)
Ops/Eng to run reliability post-mortem and share notes by 2026-02-20
People Ops to push updated hiring plan and role priorities by 2026-02-19
action_items: Ethan/Aisha: share details on 25% latency improvement experiment (due 2026-02-20)
Maya: publish feature timeline for Dedicated GA (due 2026-02-21)
Luis/Samir: compile top 5 customer case studies for marketing (due 2026-02-25)
transcript:
[00:00] Priya (CEO): Hey, everyone. Uh, good morning, good afternoon — depending where you're dialing in from. Happy Valentine’s day. We'll get started in a minute, thanks for being on time. Quick agenda: numbers, product, ops, hiring, Q&A.

[00:42] Priya: Quick call out — first, huge thanks to Eng and Ops for the incident over last week — we had an outage on a Dedicated cluster and the on-call folks did an amazing job. Aisha, can you give a 1-min summary later?

[01:20] Aisha (Head of Engineering): Yeah, hi. Uh, short summary: we traced to a kernel OOM on a bespoke runtime path for quantized 8-bit models, it affected about 7% of requests for a 45-minute window. We applied a hot fix to the allocator and rolled a canary, then a full rollout. We're running a post-mortem and we'll share the notes.

[02:15] Priya: Thanks. On the metrics front — high level — MRR grew 11% month-over-month, ARR now at $28.3M, net new logos up 18% this quarter. Churn is stable at 1.9% monthly. Big part of that is the Dedicated offering momentum and a couple of expansion deals.

[03:03] Luis (Head of Sales): Quick add — pipeline looks healthy, we closed three mid-market deals this month, one of them was a net-new in fintech who required VPC and KMS integration. CS did a great job on the security review.

[03:40] Priya: On runway and fundraising — we're pacing well after Series C; we don't need to raise immediately, focus is on hitting product milestones that unlock the next motion for enterprise.

[04:12] Maya (VP Product): Product update — Dedicated is in limited private preview, the GA target remains end of Q2. Key open items: SLA draft, autoscaling edge cases for mixed workloads, and docs for model pinning + rollout policies. Private (VPC/on-prem) pilot is ongoing with two customers. We're shipping the console improvements for tracing and token-level cost breakdown next sprint.

[05:00] Ethan (CTO): On infra — two wins: we've reduced latency tail by ~25% on average for the hosted API with a new KV cache policy and optimizer for kernel selection; also, we rolled out batching heuristics that dramatically lowered token cost for chat-heavy workloads. There are still edgecases where quantized models mis-route, that's on my list.

[05:45] Priya: Important callouts — customers ask about SOC 2 Type II and ISO readiness, so security/infra: can you confirm timeline?

[06:10] Samir (Head of CS): Security team has submitted the pre-audit docs; SOC2 Type II expected in Q3, ISO in Q4. We have a few outstanding items: retention policy docs and KMS integration checklist.

[07:05] Aisha: We'll finalize the KMS work this sprint, plus add RBAC enhancements to the console.

[07:30] Audience Q&A (Engineer): Quick product question — will the Dedicated GA support multi-tenant pooling or is it per-customer only?

[07:48] Maya: Good question — Dedicated is per-customer reserved capacity. We do plan to support sharing via subpools inside an org for cost optimization but that will be a follow-up feature after GA.

[08:30] Audience (Sales): Any changes in pricing?

[08:38] Priya: We're not changing list prices this quarter; expect clearer committed pricing for Dedicated subscribers when we publish the SLA. We'll share examples with hypothetical workloads.

[09:15] Luis: We've been testing pricing scenarios on Embeddings-heavy workloads — some customers see 30-40% cost drops with our batching and cache suggestions.

[10:00] Priya: Hiring update — we are hiring across infra, product, and sales. Current open roles prioritized: Senior Backend (2), Runtime Engineer (3), Solutions Engineer (2), Head of Legal. Recruiting funnel is slower than we'd like, People Ops is doubling down on university partnerships and agency support.

[11:05] People Ops (Speaker 1): We're targeting to fill 6 prioritized roles by end of Q2. We'll run a hiring blitz the week of Mar 2.

[12:00] Priya: OKRs — reminder that company OKR #1 is availability and reliability: SLO targets are 99.9% for hosted critical paths, Dedicated SLA to match or exceed. OKR #2 is enterprise product readiness (SLA, VPC, KMS, audit). OKR #3 is deal velocity and self-serve improvements.

[13:30] Ethan: Tech highlight — the kernel-selection compiler experiments reduced per-token time by 18% in internal benchmarks for long-context Llama-3 variants. Those optimizations got us the 25% tail improvements mentioned earlier once combined with batching and a smarter KV cache. There are still some tradeoffs with quantization levels and model fidelity; we'll publish the QA notes.

[15:00] Priya: Customer wins — shoutout to the team for a big win with Acme Financial — they moved to Dedicated reserved capacity and committed for 12 months. They required strict audit logging and KMS, so that validated our private deployment approach.

[15:45] Samir: We also shipped an eval suite for a healthcare customer that showed parity with their existing provider on critical prompts — that helped accelerate procurement.

[16:30] Priya: Marketing — new case studies coming, and we want Engineering to approve a security-blind case study by next week so we can publish.

[17:10] Q&A (Engineer): Is there a plan for supporting on-prem air-gapped installs?

[17:20] Aisha: Yes, Private on-prem is exactly that — we have a productized installer and docs but the enterprise legal/security add-ons need polishing. Targeting pilot customer installs in March.

[18:00] Q&A (Sales): Any updates on partner integrations, like with NVIDIA or cloud marketplaces?

[18:12] Priya: NVIDIA partnership conversations ongoing; marketplace listings for AWS and GCP are blocked on some billing flows but progressing.

[19:00] Maya: Also to mention — Optimize features (intelligent batching/caching suggestions) will surface recommended quantization profiles per workload in the console beta next month.

[20:00] Priya: A quick note on culture — please participate in the upcoming all-hands survey, and next company offsite is penciled for May. Travel support will be covered for those who need it.

[20:45] People Ops: We have two new parental leave policies going live; check the HR doc.

[21:30] Priya: Alright, let's recap next steps. I'll share the roadmap deck and GA timeline. Product to publish Dedicated SLA and docs. Eng to share post-mortem on the outage. People Ops to push the prioritized hiring list. Sales/CS to surface the top five case studies.

[22:10] Priya: Thanks everyone. We'll open for a few more questions.

[22:40] Q&A (Junior Engineer): Uh, how are we tracking model quality regressions across model rollouts?

[23:00] Maya: Good point. We have an eval harness tied to prompt sets; we will integrate alerting into Optimize so product teams get notified on regression thresholds. That's on the roadmap.

[24:15] Q&A (Senior Engineer): Any plan to upstream some of the runtime improvements or publish a benchmark?

[24:40] Ethan: We'll publish a paper/narrative with anonymized benchmarks and a blog post in April once we've stabilized the changes and run more reprs.

[25:30] Audience (Sales): Competitor watch — any changes in our posture vs OpenAI or Anthropic?

[25:45] Priya: We stay focused on serving and economics. Competition is strong on model capability, but our edge is predictable inference economics, hybrid deployment modes, and tools to manage rollouts and costs. Keep watching partner integrations and price movements.

[27:00] Closing remarks: Priya: Thanks again, keep shipping, talk to your managers if you have questions. We'll post the recording and notes.

[27:20] Auto-generated notes: Recording will be available in the company drive, slides attached to the calendar invite.

[27:45] (Meeting wraps; informal chatter for ~3m)

[31:00] End of recording.
